label: Single Reverse Pleat
description: A single reverse pleat is one fold per side that opens outward toward the pockets, the style associated with Italian tailoring and most ready-to-wear. It adds comfortable thigh room and keeps the inward half of the leg neat, with many considering it the more attractive of the two. It is the most common pleat found on off-the-peg trousers.
